61941.commentary: (DNa) saṃvidhātā'ti saṃvidahitā. kathaṃ saṃvidahati? aṭaviyaṃ sāsaṅkaṭṭhānesu dānasālaṃ kāretvā tattha āgate bhojetvā manusse datvā ativāheti, taṃ ṭhānaṃ pavisituṃ asakkontānaṃ manusse pesetvā paveseti. nagarādīsupi tesu tesu ṭhānesu ārakkhaṃ ṭhapeti, evaṃ saṃvidahati. saparivārañ'ca dānaṃ adāsī'ti annaṃ pānanti dasavidhaṃ dānavatthuṃ.

examples.text: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno bahujanassa sukh'āvaho ahosi, ubbega-uttāsa-bhayaṃ apanuditā, dhammikañ'ca rakkh'āvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidhātā, saparivārañ'ca dānaṃ adāsi.

tassa ce, āvuso, bhikkhuno evaṃ buddhaṃ anussarato evaṃ dhammaṃ anussarato evaṃ saṅghaṃ anussarato upekkhā kusalanissitā na saṇṭhāti, so tena saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati
imehi te hīnakāy'ūpapannā, deve tāvatiṃse abhikkamanti, saṃvegajātassa vaco nisamma, so gopako vāsavam'ajjhabhāsi.
taṃ sutvā itaro saṃvegajāto, bhāriyaṃ vata me sāhasikaṃ ananucchavikaṃ kammaṃ katan'ti bāhā paggayha kandanto vanasaṇḍaṃ pakkhanditvā tathā pakkanto'va ahosi.

61975.meaning1: developed anxiety; had a sense of urgency

examples.text: tesaṃ nisinnānaṃ abhikkamiṃsu, vīrā virāgā virajaṃ karontā, te disvā saṃvegam'akāsi vāsavo, dev'ābhibhū devagaṇassa majjhe.

61976.meaning1: experienced a sense of urgency; was startled into action
61976.commentary: (SNa) saṃvegam'āpādī'ti devatā'pi nāma maṃ evaṃ sāretī'ti vivekam'āpanno, uttamavīriyaṃ vā paggayha paramavivekaṃ maggam'eva paṭipanno'ti. (ANa) saṃvegam'āpādī'ti sot'āpanno jāto. (THIa) saṃvegam'āpādin'ti satthari dharante'pi pabbajitakiccaṃ matthakaṃ pāpetuṃ asakkontī pacchā kathaṃ pāpayissāmī'ti saṃvegaṃ ñāṇ'utrāsaṃ āpajjiṃ.

examples.text: aladdhā cetaso santiṃ, citte avasavattinī, tato saṃvegam'āpādiṃ, saritvā jinasāsanaṃ.
atha kho so bhikkhu tāya devatāya saṃvejito saṃvegam'āpādī'ti.

61978.meaning1: arouses a sense of urgency; experiences trepidation

examples.text: tassa ce, āvuso, bhikkhuno evaṃ buddhaṃ anussarato evaṃ dhammaṃ anussarato evaṃ saṅghaṃ anussarato upekkhā kusalanissitā na saṇṭhāti, so tena saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati

61979.meaning1: anxious; feeling a sense of urgency

examples.text: asso yathā bhadro kasāniviṭṭho, ātāpino saṃvegino bhavātha, saddhāya sīlena ca vīriyena ca, samādhinā dhammavinicchayena ca, sampannavijjācaraṇā patissatā, jahissatha dukkham'idaṃ anappakaṃ.

61981.meaning1: alarming; arousing urgency; jolting into action; dismaying
61981.meaning2: apt to cause emotion or anxiety

examples.text: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye saṃvejaniyesu ṭhānesu saṃvijjanti, atha kho et'eva sattā bahutarā ye saṃvejaniyesu ṭhānesu na saṃvijjanti.

61982.meaning2: to be remembered with grief or reverence

examples.text: cattār'imāni, ānanda, saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyāni saṃvejanīyāni ṭhānāni
atha kho bāhiyo dārucīriyo tāya devatāya saṃvejito tāva'd'eva suppārakamhā pakkāmi. sabbattha ekarattiparivāsena yena sāvatthi jetavanaṃ anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo ten'upasaṅkami.

61985.meaning1: alarms; frightens; shocks; awes; shakes up

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa etadahosi, atibāḷhaṃ kho ayaṃ yakkho pamatto viharati. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imaṃ yakkhaṃ saṃvejeyyan'ti.
tena hi tvaṃ brāhmaṇa, bhiyyosomattāya brahmānañ'ca brahmaparisañ'ca brahmapārisajje ca saṃvejehī'ti.

61987.meaning1: wishing to stir up; wanting to create a sense of urgency

examples.text: atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā tassa bhikkhuno anukampikā atthakāmā taṃ bhikkhuṃ saṃvejetu'kāmā yena so bhikkhu ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi

61988.meaning1: to stir up; to shock; to create a sense of urgency

examples.text: atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā tassa bhikkhuno anukampikā atthakāmā taṃ bhikkhuṃ saṃvejetu'kāmā yena so bhikkhu ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi

61989.meaning1: having stirred up; having alarmed; having shocked; having inspired awe
61989.commentary: (PMa) saṃvejetvā cittaṃ samādahatī'ti saṃvegaṃ uppādetvā ten'eva saṃvegena cittaṃ samāhitaṃ karoti.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā taṃ brahmānaṃ saṃvejetvā, seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya evam'eva, tasmiṃ brahmaloke antarahito jetavane pāturahosi.

obhāsavasena saṃvego uppajjati, saṃvegavasena saddhāvasena saddh'indriyaṃ adhimattaṃ hoti. saṃvejetvā cittaṃ samādahati, samādhivasena saddhāvasena saddh'indriyaṃ adhimattaṃ hoti. tathā samāhitaṃ cittaṃ sādhukaṃ paggaṇhāti, paggahavasena saddhāvasena saddh'indriyaṃ adhimattaṃ hoti.

61990.meaning1: alarmed; frightened; shocked; awed; shook up

examples.text: yo vejayantaṃ pāsādaṃ, pād'aṅguṭṭhena kampayi, iddhibalen'upatthaddho, saṃvejesi ca devatā.

61992.meaning1: having twisted together; having woven together
61992.commentary: (VINa) anto saṃveṭhetvā baddhaṃ hotī'ti heṭṭhā ca upari ca vitthataṃ majjhe saṅkhittaṃ paṇavasaṇṭhānaṃ katvā baddhaṃ hoti, taṃ kira majjhe sīha-byaggha-camma-parikkhittam'pi karonti.

examples.text: kocchaṃ nāma, vākamayaṃ vā usīramayaṃ vā muñjamayaṃ vā pabbajamayaṃ vā anto saṃveṭhetvā baddhaṃ hoti.

61994.grammar: prp of caus pass of saṃ √vis, caus, pass, intrans (+instr)
61994.meaning1: being put to bed; being laid down (by)

examples.text: ambho purisa, na tvaṃ addasa manussesu itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā ābādhikaṃ dukkhitaṃ bāḷhagilānaṃ, sake muttakarīse palipannaṃ semānaṃ, aññehi vuṭṭhāpiyamānaṃ, aññehi saṃvesiyamānan'ti?

61995.grammar: ptp of caus of saṃ √vis, caus (+acc)
61995.meaning1: should be laid down; should be put to bed

examples.text: ime te, ambho purisa, cattāro āsīvisā uggatejā ghoravisā kālena kālaṃ vuṭṭhāpetabbā, kālena kālaṃ nhāpetabbā, kālena kālaṃ bhojetabbā, kālena kālaṃ saṃvesetabbā.

61996.grammar: abs of caus of saṃ √vis, caus, trans (+acc)
61996.meaning1: having laid down; having made lie down

examples.text: so tattha dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti, na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti. tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā saṃvesetvā kuṭhārīhi tacchanti.

idha, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvoharamāno evaṃ jānāti, aññathā kho ayam'āyasmā ekena eko voharati, aññathā dvīhi, aññathā tīhi, aññathā sambahulehi, vokkamati ayam'āyasmā purimavohārā pacchimavohāraṃ, aparisuddhavohāro ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā parisuddhavohāro'ti.
yo pana bhikkhu nānappakārakaṃ rūpiyasaṃvohāraṃ samāpajjeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

61999.commentary: (SNa) saṃvohārenā'ti kathanena… ettha kathā vohāro. idhā'pi eso'va adhippeto. ekaccassa hi sammukhā kathā parammukhāya kathāya na sameti, parammukhā kathā ca sammukhāya kathāya, tathā purimakathā ca pacchimakathāya, pacchimakathā ca purimakathāya. so kathenten'eva sakkā jānituṃ, asuci eso puggalo'ti.

examples.text: saṃvohārena kho mahārāja, soceyyaṃ veditabbaṃ. tañ'ca kho dīghena addhunā, na ittaraṃ, manasikarotā, no amanasikarotā, paññavatā, no duppaññena.
